import torch
from tslearn.metrics import SquaredEuclidean

# SquaredEuclidean is a PyTorch distance function used by SoftDTWLossPyTorch
se = SquaredEuclidean()

# Prepare small batch of PyTorch tensors from the provided datasets
# x_t: (batch_size, n_timestamps_x, n_features)
# y_t: (batch_size, n_timestamps_y, n_features)
x_t = torch.tensor(X[:2], dtype=torch.float32)
y_t = torch.tensor(X2[:2], dtype=torch.float32)

# Compute pairwise squared Euclidean distances between timestamps for each batch element
dist = se(x_t, y_t)

# Verify the output shape is (batch_size, n_timestamps_x, n_timestamps_y)
expected_shape = (2, X.shape[1], X2.shape[1])
assert dist.shape == expected_shape, f"Expected shape {expected_shape}, got {dist.shape}"

# Verify the correctness of a specific pairwise distance
expected_val = torch.sum((x_t[0, 0] - y_t[0, 0]) ** 2)
assert torch.isclose(dist[0, 0, 0], expected_val, atol=1e-5), \
    f"Expected distance {expected_val}, got {dist[0, 0, 0]}"
